comparison_scope: Primary batch-1 serving decode profile for headline t/s/u. TTFT is reported separately and is not blended into the TPOT-derived decode value beyond normal single-request timing.
command_string: /home/ttuser/.tenstorrent-venv/bin/vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --base-url http://localhost:8021 --endpoint /v1/completions --dataset-name random --random-input-len 128 --random-output-len 128 --num-prompts 1 --ignore-eos --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --save-result --result-filename /home/ttuser/dev/qwen3.8-flash-next/tt-metal/models/autoports/qwen_qwen3_8_flash_next/doc/optimized_vllm/after/vllm_result.json --max-concurrency 1 --temperature 0.0
mean_per_request_decode_tps_basis: 1000 / mean_tpot_ms from vllm bench serve; this is the TPOT-derived decode value. For burst-serving profiles, scheduler admission and chunked prefill can affect TPOT, so use the single-user profile for headline decode t/s/u.
